name: financial_calculator
description: Calculate financial metrics including compound interest, loan repayments, ROI, present value, future value, and break-even analysis. Call this function to compute mortgage payments, model investment growth, assess return on investment, discount future cash flows, or determine break-even points for a business. Specify calculator_type and provide the relevant numeric inputs. No external API required — all calculations run locally.

calculator_type.description: Calculation mode: compound_interest, loan_repayment, roi, present_value, future_value, or break_even.

principal.description: Starting or loan amount. Used for compound_interest, loan_repayment, future_value.

rate.description: Annual rate as percentage. e.g. 5 for 5%.

initial_value.description: Investment starting value. Used for roi.

final_value.description: Investment ending value. Used for roi and present_value.

discount_rate.description: Discount rate percentage. Used for present_value.

future_amount.description: Future cash amount to discount. Used for present_value.

fixed_costs.description: Total fixed costs. Used for break_even.

variable_cost_per_unit.description: Variable cost per unit. Used for break_even.

price_per_unit.description: Selling price per unit. Used for break_even.
